newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen handles 508,000 TEUs in first 11 months.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen handles 508,000 TEUs in first 11 months.

text.p: Shenzhen's ports handled 508,000 twenty-foot equivalent units (TEUs) between January and November, the official Shenzhen Economic Daily said on Thursday.
This ranked it fourth in China compared with seventh in the same period of 1995, the newspaper said
Shenzhen has three harbours -- Yantian, Shekou and Chiwan -- with five advanced container ports between them, the paper added.
In the period, Yantian handled 310,000 TEUs, Shekou 118,000 and Chiwan 80,000, placing Shenzhen's container capacity behind Shanghai, Tianjin and Qingdao, it said. It gave no year-earlier figures.

The newspaper attributed Shenzhen's rise in the rankings to the city government's efforts to bring its port operating system closer to international practices through a series of reforms. It gave no further details.
